description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterCacheResource, which provides a method to unregister a cache resource in the Smarty templating engine. It includes the implementation of the method unregisterCacheResource that interacts with Smarty's registered cache resources.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterCacheResource
classes.description: Class providing functionality to unregister a cache resource in Smarty.

methods.name: unregisterCacheResource
methods.description: Unregisters a cache resource by name from Smarty's registered cache resources.
